title: User tiers get a place in the dashboard
summary:
User tiers reached the dashboard and GPT Image routing, while an AI accessibility tool joined the community project list.

Added seed, flower, and nectar user tiers, with seed as the default. The auth dashboard displays a user's tier, and the Special Bee form explains how to request flower tier. This does not add tier-based limits or automatic upgrades.

Authenticated GPT Image requests now route by user tier instead of random endpoint selection. Requests without tier information use seed routing; GPT Image still requires authentication.

The README and website project list added AI Content Describer, an NVDA extension by @cartertemm that uses multimodal AI to describe images, UI controls, and diagrams for blind and visually impaired Windows users.

highlights.title: See your user tier
highlights.text: The auth dashboard shows whether your account is seed, flower, or nectar. The Special Bee form explains how to request flower tier.
